excerpt_i18n.en: On July 22, 2026, Acemate officially signed an agreement with the 2026 China Open. Under the partnership, Acemate will serve as the exclusive designated tennis training robot supplier for the 2026 China Open, entering the tournament's cooperation ecosystem. The significance of this collaboration goes beyond a simple tournament partnership announcement. For Acemate, it marks a key milestone as its AI tennis training robot moves from daily training, club experiences, and shared courts into the professional tournament arena. This means that the new category of AI tennis training robots is entering a more authentic, higher-standard tennis environment with greater public attention. The China Open is one of Asia's highest-level comprehensive international tennis tournaments for both men and women. As a vital platform connecting Chinese tennis with the world, the China Open not only hosts top-tier competitive events but also continuously expands scenarios integrating tournament experience, fan interaction, and sports technology. Acemate’s entry into the China Open partnership is based on a shared focus on "upgrading tennis training experiences." Unlike traditional ball-feeding devices, the Acemate AI tennis training robot is capable of moving, catching, serving, human-robot rallying, and recording and analyzing training data. Through AI visual perception and robot motion control, Acemate aims to transform solo tennis training from one-way ball feeding to something closer to real-game movement, judgment, and continuous rallying.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 22 de julio de 2026, Acemate y el Abierto de China de 2026 firmaron oficialmente un acuerdo. Según los términos de la colaboración, Acemate participará en el Abierto de China como el proveedor oficial exclusivo de robots de entrenamiento de tenis. El significado de esta colaboración va más allá de un simple anuncio de patrocinio deportivo. Para Acemate, este es un hito importante en el paso de los robots de entrenamiento de tenis con IA desde escenarios como el entrenamiento diario, la experiencia en clubes y las pistas compartidas hacia el sistema de competiciones profesionales.
